Role Responsibilities

The Citizen Experience branch is looking for a Full Stack Developer. Reporting
to the Delivery Manager, deliver hands-on development and operational support
across the platform lifecycle. The position applies established development
practices to implement changes, resolve issues, support ongoing maintenance,
and contribute to modernization and continuous improvement efforts.

The responsibilities of this role include:

- Developing and maintaining front-end and back-end platform components and
  services in large-scale enterprise environments using modern software
  development practices.
- Assessing technical requirements and delivering platform changes,
  enhancements, defect fixes, and ongoing maintenance.
- Providing production support, troubleshooting platform issues, and
  coordinating timely resolution of incidents and defects.
- Supporting cloud platforms and contributing to scalable, reusable technical
  solutions.
- Applying software development, platform, testing, data, and technical
  standards to support reliable and maintainable solutions.
- Apply AI-enabled tools and automation to accelerate delivery and improve
  quality, while validating outputs and safeguarding sensitive information.
- Collaborating with product teams, technical teams, vendors, and stakeholders
  to support delivery priorities and continuous improvement.

To be successful in this position, you will demonstrate:

- Ability to communicate technical information clearly and work effectively
  with multidisciplinary delivery teams.
- Knowledge of Agile delivery approaches, service design or human-centred
  design concepts, and continuous delivery of value.
- Ability to understand user needs, work within technical and organizational
  constraints, and contribute to collaborative delivery work.
- Strong troubleshooting, judgment, teamwork, and delivery support skills.

Qualifications

- A university degree in computer science, information technology, software
  engineering, or a related technical field, supplemented by two years of
  progressively responsible related experience.
- Experience developing, maintaining, and supporting applications or platforms
  using modern digital delivery practices.
- Experience developing and maintaining cloud-based applications and services
  using .NET, C#, JavaScript, React, and SQL.
- Working knowledge of software architecture, common design patterns, and
  computing science principles, with the ability to apply them in application
  or platform development.
- Experience designing, querying, and maintaining relational databases.

Assets

- Experience developing or supporting payment processing or financial
  management systems.
- Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills in application and
  production environments.
- Experience with AI-assisted development tools, CI/CD pipelines, automation,
  or DevOps practices.
- Experience with alternative database technologies and models.
